999008199.text:
少しずつだけど前には進めてるね！
魔物も強いけど、まだなんとかなってる！

localizations.en: We're making progress, bit by bit! The monsters are tough, but we're managing so far!

999008199.text:
今のところは、ですが。
奥に進むにつれて魔物が強くなるのが一般的です

localizations.en: For now, at least. Generally speaking, the creatures grow stronger the deeper you venture.

999008199.text: この先ずっとこんな景色が続くのかなあ……

localizations.en: Wonder if it's gonna be nothing but this scenery from here on out...

999008199.text:
……ん？
あれは……氷とは違う、何かあるわ！

localizations.en: ...Hm? What's that...? There's something other than ice over there!

999008199.text:
もっと近づいてみたら何か分かるかな？
船長、寄ってみて！

localizations.en: Maybe we can tell what it is if we get closer? Captain, take us in!

999008199.text: 一刀両断されてるわね。すごい切り口

localizations.en: Cut clean in two. What a precise slice.

999008199.text:
あのお爺ちゃんが話してたよね。
船は頂獣に真っ二つにされちゃったって……

localizations.en: The old man told us about this, remember? How the ships got torn in half by the Apexi...
To split such a massive ship...

999008199.text:
せっかくだし、ちょっと調べてみる？
何か頂獣討伐の手掛かりがあるかも！

localizations.en: Since we're here anyway, wanna check it out? Might find some clues for taking down the Apexi!

999008199.text:
うん、そうだね！
行こう、レスナちゃん！

localizations.en: Yeah, good idea! Let's go, Resna!

999008199.text: あんたたち、この天才の存在も忘れるんじゃないわよ！

localizations.en: Don't you two forget about this genius here!

999008199.text:
九偉人と違い、丈夫な身体でもないのに、この状況でも
前に進む精神力。評価に値します

localizations.en: Unlike the Nine, you possess no enhanced durability, yet you press forward even in these conditions. That mental fortitude is commendable.

999008199.text: さすが、マスターたちが目をかけ育ててきた人材ですね

localizations.en: Truly worthy of being those whom the Masters have chosen to nurture.
